### What would you like SleepManager to do?

### Why would it be useful?

### Device or app (if relevant)

### If this is an app integration

Please include the app/repository link and, if known:

- whether it exposes an official Intent / ContentProvider / automation API
- whether its current state can be queried
- whether start/stop/pause/resume can be confirmed
- whether the API changes the user's persistent settings
- any minimum app version or permission requirement

SleepManager prefers state-aware, ownership-safe integrations and avoids force-stopping apps or relying on undocumented internals.
